blurb: On Workers the upgrade is routed to the Durable Object that hosts the connection before the `on open` body runs, so the edge has to work out the agent's key on its own. A route parameter, a `const` of the context or of a commons it `uses`, or a literal can be evaluated there. A key computed in the body, such as a `let`, cannot, because the body has not run. Key the agent by a parameter of `on open`, a constant, or a literal. The bundle target runs the body first, so it does not check this.
summary: On the Workers target, the key of a WebSocket `on open` handler's connection transfer is not a route parameter, a constant of the context or of a commons it uses, or a literal — the upgrade is routed to the hosting Durable Object before the body runs, so the edge must be able to evaluate the key on its own.
